about.title: A Lifelong Journey
about.p1.2: years old and live in Kyiv, Ukraine. While my education is in philosophy and theology, and my professional background includes marketing and sales, I eventually discovered my true passion in the tech industry and programming. Web development has always fascinated me. I love the frontend as the first impression people have of a service, while the backend feels like a mysterious clockwork mechanism quietly powering everything behind the scenes.
about.p2: What I enjoy most about programming, especially today, is that it encourages me to learn something new every day, develop new skills, and gain fresh perspectives on things I thought I already understood. It's a journey I truly enjoy, and one I believe will never really end...
about.p3: In my free time, I enjoy taking long walks in nature, learning new skills, exploring gaming worlds, playing chess, or searching for hidden gems in the night sky with my telescope.
